title: Mahalakshmi Ashtakam
intro: Mahalakshmi Ashtakam is a powerful prayer chanted to invoke the grace, wealth, and prosperity of Goddess Lakshmi.
description:
|| Sri Mahalakshmyashtakam ||

Sri Ganeshaya Namah

Namostu Maha Maye, Shri Pithe Sura Pujite |
Shankha Chakra Gada Haste, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 1 ||

Namaste Garudarudhe, Kolasura Bhayankari |
Sarva Papa Hare Devi, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 2 ||

Sarvajne Sarva Varade, Sarva Dushta Bhayankari |
Sarva Duhkha Hare Devi, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 3 ||

Siddhi Buddhi Prade Devi, Bhukti Mukti Pradayini |
Mantra Murte Sada Devi, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 4 ||

Adhyanta Rahite Devi, Adhya Shakti Maheshvari |
YogaJe Yoga Sambhute, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 5 ||

Sthula Sookshma Maha Raudre, Maha Shakti Mahodare |
Maha Papa Hare Devi, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 6 ||

Padmasana Sthite Devi, Parabrahma Svaroopini |
Parameshi Jaganmatar, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 7 ||

Shvetambara Dhare Devi, Nanalankara Bhushite |
Jagat Sthite Jaganmatar, Mahalakshmi Namostute || 8 ||

Mahalakshmyashtakastotram, Yah Pathet Bhaktiman Narah |
Sarva Siddhim Avapnoti, Rajyam Prapnoti Sarvada || 9 ||

Eka Kale Pathen Nityam, Maha Papa Vinashanam |
Dvi Kalam Yah Pathen Nityam, Dhana Dhanya Samanvitah || 10 ||

Tri Kalam Yah Pathen Nityam, Maha Shatru Vinashanam |
Mahalakshmir Bhaven Nityam, Prasanna Varada Shubha || 11 ||

|| Iti Indrakrita Sri Mahalakshmyashtaka Stotram Sampoornam ||

faq.a1: According to ancient scriptures and traditions, this divine hymn was composed by Lord Indra (the king of the gods) to invoke and please Goddess Lakshmi.
faq.q2: What are the benefits of reciting Mahalakshmi Ashtakam?
faq.a2: Regular recitation brings wealth, abundance, and prosperity, helps overcome major sins and life crises, provides protection from obstacles, and ensures the eternal grace of Goddess Lakshmi.
faq.q3: Which day and time are best to read Mahalakshmi Ashtakam?
faq.a3: It can be recited daily during morning and evening prayers. Specifically, Fridays and the auspicious festival of Diwali are considered extremely sacred and powerful for chanting this stotram.
faq.q4: Can Mahalakshmi Ashtakam be recited more than once a day?
faq.a4: Yes. According to the text itself: reciting it once destroys major sins, reciting it twice a day (morning and evening) brings wealth and abundance, and reciting it thrice daily destroys adversaries and secures the supreme blessings of Goddess Lakshmi.
faq.q5: Are there any special rules or restrictions for reciting Mahalakshmi Ashtakam?
faq.a5: Anyone with faith, devotion, and cleanliness can recite it. There are no rigid restrictions; a pure mind and absolute devotion to Goddess Lakshmi are what matter the most.
